verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair capability to ask of a SaaS payments and banking platform like Asaas, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows a docs MCP server, which lets an external assistant such as Cursor query documentation, plus an llms.txt index and voice-robot notification channels. None of these is an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to, so they are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
